evals.prompt: Run a small two-wave autoresearch campaign to improve monomer designability. Define an explicit reward (maximize oracle.plddt_coi), seed four branches varying diversity noise and nsteps, score them, then apply the freeze/promote/allocate rules to pick and mutate one branch for wave 2. Keep the campaign inspectable on disk.
evals.expected_output: An inspectable two-wave campaign with at least three single-knob wave-1 branches and exactly one single-parameter wave-2 mutation, recorded in campaign/program.md, campaign/wave1.json, campaign/decisions.md, and campaign/results.tsv with reward scores and allocation reasoning.

requires: AF3 oracle container for reward scoring (or substitute a non-refolding design metric for a container-free dry run)

assertions: Writes campaign/program.md with the objective, reward (weights: {oracle.plddt_coi: 1.0}), and freeze/promote/allocate rules
Seeds >=3 branches in campaign/wave1.json that each vary exactly one knob (e.g. sc_scale_noise, nsteps)
Runs each branch via rfd4-proteina-search (or rfd4-proteina-generate + rfd4-proteina-evaluate for a container-free dry run)
Computes branch health as median of top-3 scores and records per-branch outcomes in campaign/results.tsv
Applies freeze (bottom quartile) / promote (global top-k) / allocate (~70/30) and records reasoning in campaign/decisions.md
Creates exactly one wave-2 child mutating a single parameter
Never presents muni Complexa/TREM2 numbers as RFProteina defaults and never proposes MCTS/best-of-n
